## What changed / 修改内容

Explain the user or data problem and the change that addresses it.

说明改了什么，以及它解决的用户或数据问题。

## Sources / 来源

List sources for new or changed facts, coordinates, and images. Write “Not applicable / 不适用” when no data is involved.

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] `npm run validate:data`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e`
- [ ] Chinese and English content remain complete / 中英文内容完整
- [ ] Desktop and mobile checked for visible changes / 已检查桌面和移动端
- [ ] New images have verified subject, author, and license / 新图片已核验主题、作者和许可证
